notification-island.title: Notification Island
notification-island.tagline: OxygenOS Live Alerts inspired notification island
notification-island.description: An OxygenOS Live Alerts-inspired notification island for web apps. Expands on incoming alerts, steps through queued items with a split arrow pill, and opens a persistent notification drawer.

"use client";

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, MotionConfig, motion } from "motion/react";
import { Bell, CheckCheck, ChevronRight, Trash2, X } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { NotificationCard, NotificationStatusIcon } from "./notification-card";
import {
  notify,
  useNotifications,
  type NotificationAction,
  type NotificationItem,
  type NotificationType,
  type NotifyOptions,
} from "./use-notifications";

export {
  notify,
  useNotifications,
  type NotificationAction,
  type NotificationItem,
  type NotificationType,
  type NotifyOptions,
};

export interface NotificationIslandProps {
  /** Alignment anchor inside a header bar ("center" expands symmetrically, "right" expands leftward). */
  align?: "center" | "left" | "right";
  /** Default live popup preview duration in milliseconds before collapsing back to the bell. */
  popupDuration?: number;
  /** Optional custom bell icon element. */
  bellIcon?: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

export function NotificationIsland({
  align = "center",
  popupDuration = 4000,
  bellIcon,
  className,
}: NotificationIslandProps) {
  const [isPopupHovered, setIsPopupHovered] = useState(false);
  const [isArrowHovered, setIsArrowHovered] = useState(false);
  const [isClickedOpen, setIsClickedOpen] = useState(false);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const isExpandedRequest = isPopupHovered || isClickedOpen;

  const {
    notifications,
    unreadCount,
    popupItems,
    activePopup,
    activeIndex,
    direction,
    activeProgress,
    nextPopup,
  } = useNotifications(isExpandedRequest || isArrowHovered, popupDuration);

  const hasActivePopup = popupItems.length > 0 && activePopup !== null;
  const isOpen = isClickedOpen;
  const hasMultiplePopups = popupItems.length > 1;
  const isCompactPopup = hasActivePopup && !isOpen;

  // Close drawer when clicking outside
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleOutsidePointerDown(event: PointerEvent) {
      if (
        isClickedOpen &&
        containerRef.current &&
        !containerRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)
      ) {
        setIsClickedOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", handleOutsidePointerDown);
    return () =>
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", handleOutsidePointerDown);
  }, [isClickedOpen]);

  function handleMouseEnter() {
    if (!hasActivePopup) return;
    setIsPopupHovered(true);
  }

  function handleMouseLeave() {
    setIsPopupHovered(false);
  }

  const wrapperAlignClass = {
    center: "justify-center",
    left: "justify-start",
    right: "justify-end",
  }[align];

  const dropdownAlignClass = {
    center: "left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2",
    left: "left-0",
    right: "right-0",
  }[align];

  return (
    <MotionConfig
      transition={{
        type: "spring",
        stiffness: 400,
        damping: 32,
        mass: 0.85,
      }}
    >
      <div
        ref={containerRef}
        className={cn(
          "relative flex items-center",
          wrapperAlignClass,
          className,
        )}
      >
        <div className="relative flex items-center">
          {/* Main Fixed-Height Bell / Compact Popup Pill (never expands navbar height) */}
          <motion.div
            initial={false}
            animate={{
              width: isCompactPopup ? 280 : 40,
            }}
            onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter}
            onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
            onClick={() => {
              setIsClickedOpen((prev) => !prev);
            }}
            role="button"
            tabIndex={0}
            aria-expanded={isOpen}
            aria-label={
              unreadCount > 0
                ? `Notifications (${unreadCount} unread)`
                : "Notifications"
            }
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
                e.preventDefault();
                setIsClickedOpen((prev) => !prev);
              } else if (e.key === "Escape" && isOpen) {
                setIsClickedOpen(false);
                setIsPopupHovered(false);
              }
            }}
            className={cn(
              "relative flex h-10 max-w-[92vw] cursor-pointer items-center overflow-hidden rounded-full border border-accent/40 inset-shadow-sm shadow-accent backdrop-blur-3xl transition-colors select-none",
              !isCompactPopup && "bg-surface/40 hover:border-accent/70",
              isCompactPopup && "bg-surface/70",
              isOpen && "border-accent/75 bg-surface/65",
            )}
          >
            {/* Idle Bell Icon (stays visible when menu is open, hides only during compact live toast) */}
            <motion.div
              aria-hidden={isCompactPopup}
              initial={false}
              animate={{
                opacity: isCompactPopup ? 0 : 1,
                scale: isCompactPopup ? 0.55 : 1,
                filter: isCompactPopup ? "blur(4px)" : "blur(0px)",
              }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.16, ease: "easeOut" }}
              className="pointer-events-none absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 flex size-6 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center text-foreground"
            >
              {bellIcon ?? <Bell className="size-4" />}
            </motion.div>

            <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
              {/* COMPACT LIVE POPUP STATE */}
              {isCompactPopup && activePopup && (
                <motion.div
                  key="compact-popup"
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, filter: "blur(4px)" }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, filter: "blur(4px)" }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.18, delay: 0.04 }}
                  className="relative flex h-10 w-full items-center overflow-hidden px-3.5"
                >
                  <AnimatePresence
                    mode="popLayout"
                    custom={direction}
                    initial={false}
                  >
                    <motion.div
                      key={activePopup.id}
                      custom={direction}
                      initial={{
                        opacity: 0,
                        x: direction * 22,
                        filter: "blur(3px)",
                      }}
                      animate={{
                        opacity: 1,
                        x: 0,
                        filter: "blur(0px)",
                      }}
                      exit={{
                        opacity: 0,
                        x: direction * -22,
                        filter: "blur(3px)",
                      }}
                      transition={{
                        type: "spring",
                        stiffness: 440,
                        damping: 32,
                      }}
                      className="flex w-full min-w-0 items-center gap-2.5"
                    >
                      <NotificationStatusIcon item={activePopup} />
                      <span className="truncate text-xs font-medium text-foreground">
                        {activePopup.title}
                      </span>
                    </motion.div>
                  </AnimatePresence>

                  {/* Subtle bottom countdown progress bar */}
                  {(activePopup.duration ?? popupDuration) !== Infinity && (
                    <span
                      aria-hidden
                      style={{ transform: `scaleX(${activeProgress})` }}
                      className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 bottom-0 left-3 h-[1.5px] origin-left rounded-full bg-accent/65 transition-transform duration-75"
                    />
                  )}
                </motion.div>
              )}
            </AnimatePresence>
          </motion.div>

          {/* Idle Bell Unread Badge */}
          <AnimatePresence>
            {!isCompactPopup && unreadCount > 0 && (
              <motion.span
                key="bell-unread-badge"
                initial={{ scale: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
                exit={{ scale: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                className="pointer-events-none absolute -top-1 -right-1 flex min-w-4 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-accent px-1 font-mono text-[9px] font-bold text-white shadow-sm"
              >
                {unreadCount > 99 ? "99+" : unreadCount}
              </motion.span>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>

          {/* OnePlus-style Detached Rounded Arrow Switcher Pill (anchored on the right in the bell's spot; island slides out left) */}
          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            {isCompactPopup && hasMultiplePopups && (
              <motion.button
                key="island-next-arrow"
                type="button"
                onMouseEnter={() => setIsArrowHovered(true)}
                onMouseLeave={() => setIsArrowHovered(false)}
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  nextPopup();
                }}
                aria-label={`Next notification (${activeIndex + 1} of ${popupItems.length})`}
                title={`Switch notification (${activeIndex + 1}/${popupItems.length})`}
                initial={{
                  opacity: 0,
                  scale: 0.4,
                  width: 0,
                  marginLeft: 0,
                }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, width: 40, marginLeft: 8 }}
                exit={{
                  opacity: 0,
                  scale: 0.4,
                  width: 0,
                  marginLeft: 0,
                }}
                whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }}
                className="group relative z-20 flex h-10 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-accent/40 bg-surface/65 inset-shadow-sm shadow-accent backdrop-blur-3xl transition-colors hover:border-accent/70 hover:bg-surface/85"
              >
                <ChevronRight className="size-4 text-foreground transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-0.5" />
                <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 flex size-4 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-accent font-mono text-[9px] font-bold text-white shadow-sm">
                  {popupItems.length}
                </span>
              </motion.button>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>

          {/* Floating Glassy Notification Center Popover Dropdown */}
          <AnimatePresence>
            {isOpen && (
              <motion.div
                key="notification-center"
                initial={{
                  opacity: 0,
                  y: -8,
                  scale: 0.96,
                  filter: "blur(4px)",
                }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -8, scale: 0.96, filter: "blur(4px)" }}
                transition={{
                  type: "spring",
                  stiffness: 420,
                  damping: 32,
                  mass: 0.85,
                }}
                onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                className={cn(
                  "absolute top-[calc(100%+10px)] z-50 flex w-[min(92vw,372px)] flex-col gap-2.5 rounded-3xl border border-accent/25 bg-background/72 bg-[linear-gradient(color-mix(in_srgb,var(--accent)_9%,transparent),color-mix(in_srgb,var(--accent)_9%,transparent))] p-3 shadow-[0_24px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.16)] ring-1 inset-shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,59,0,0.08)] ring-white/40 backdrop-blur-[80px] backdrop-saturate-150 dark:bg-background/75 dark:shadow-[0_24px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.55)] dark:ring-white/12",
                  dropdownAlignClass,
                )}
              >
                {/* Drawer Header */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1 pb-0.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                      {bellIcon ?? <Bell className="size-3.5" />}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                      Notifications
                    </span>
                    {unreadCount > 0 && (
                      <span className="rounded-full bg-accent/15 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold text-accent">
                        {unreadCount} new
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    {unreadCount > 0 && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => notify.markAllRead()}
                        title="Mark all as read"
                        className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-surface/80 hover:text-foreground"
                      >
                        <CheckCheck className="size-3" />
                        <span>Mark read</span>
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {notifications.length > 0 && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => notify.clear()}
                        title="Clear all notifications"
                        className="rounded-full p-1 text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-surface/80 hover:text-foreground"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="size-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {isClickedOpen && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setIsClickedOpen(false);
                          setIsPopupHovered(false);
                        }}
                        aria-label="Close notifications"
                        className="rounded-full p-1 text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-surface/80 hover:text-foreground"
                      >
                        <X className="size-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Solid Notification List */}
                <div className="thin-scrollbar flex max-h-[320px] flex-col gap-1.5 overflow-y-auto pr-0.5">
                  {notifications.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-2xl bg-card/95 py-8 text-center">
                      <Bell className="size-5 text-muted-foreground/60" />
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                        All caught up
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/70">
                        New notifications will appear here.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
                      {notifications.map((item) => (
                        <NotificationCard
                          key={item.id}
                          item={item}
                          onMarkRead={(id) => notify.markAsRead(id)}
                          onRemove={(id) => notify.remove(id)}
                        />
                      ))}
                    </AnimatePresence>
                  )}
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      </div>
    </MotionConfig>
  );
}

"use client";

import React from "react";
import { motion } from "motion/react";
import {
  AlertCircle,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Info,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { NotificationItem } from "./use-notifications";

export function NotificationStatusIcon({ item }: { item: NotificationItem }) {
  if (item.avatarUrl) {
    return (
      <img
        src={item.avatarUrl}
        alt=""
        className="size-5 shrink-0 rounded-full object-cover ring-1 ring-border"
      />
    );
  }

  if (item.icon) {
    return (
      <span className="flex size-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center">
        {item.icon}
      </span>
    );
  }

  switch (item.type) {
    case "success":
      return <CheckCircle2 className="size-4 shrink-0 text-success" />;
    case "error":
      return <AlertCircle className="size-4 shrink-0 text-destructive" />;
    case "warning":
      return <AlertTriangle className="size-4 shrink-0 text-warning" />;
    case "info":
      return <Info className="size-4 shrink-0 text-info" />;
    default:
      return (
        <span className="size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-accent shadow-[0_0_8px_var(--accent)]" />
      );
  }
}

interface NotificationCardProps {
  item: NotificationItem;
  onMarkRead: (id: string) => void;
  onRemove: (id: string) => void;
}

export function NotificationCard({
  item,
  onMarkRead,
  onRemove,
}: NotificationCardProps) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      layout
      initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.94, height: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.16 }}
      onClick={() => {
        if (!item.read) onMarkRead(item.id);
      }}
      className={cn(
        "group relative flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-2.5 rounded-2xl border p-2.5 text-left transition-colors",
        !item.read
          ? "border-accent/35 bg-card shadow-xs hover:bg-surface-secondary"
          : "border-border/80 bg-surface hover:bg-surface-secondary",
      )}
    >
      <div className="mt-0.5 shrink-0">
        <NotificationStatusIcon item={item} />
      </div>

      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <p className="text-xs leading-snug font-medium text-foreground">
            {item.title}
          </p>
          {item.timestamp && (
            <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
              {item.timestamp}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {item.description && (
          <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            {item.description}
          </p>
        )}

        {item.action && (
          <div className="pt-1">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                item.action?.onClick();
                onMarkRead(item.id);
              }}
              className="rounded-full bg-accent px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-white transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"
            >
              {item.action.label}
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
        {!item.read && (
          <span
            aria-label="Unread"
            className="size-1.5 rounded-full bg-accent"
          />
        )}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            onRemove(item.id);
          }}
          aria-label="Remove notification"
          className="rounded-full p-1 text-muted-foreground opacity-60 transition-colors hover:bg-surface-tertiary hover:text-foreground hover:opacity-100"
        >
          <X className="size-3.5" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

"use client";

import type React from "react";
import {
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  useState,
  useSyncExternalStore,
} from "react";

export type NotificationType =
  "default" | "success" | "info" | "warning" | "error";

export interface NotificationAction {
  label: string;
  onClick: () => void;
}

export interface NotificationItem {
  id: string;
  title: React.ReactNode;
  description?: React.ReactNode;
  type?: NotificationType;
  timestamp?: string;
  read: boolean;
  avatarUrl?: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  duration?: number;
  action?: NotificationAction;
}

export type NotifyOptions = Omit<NotificationItem, "id" | "title" | "read"> & {
  id?: string;
  silent?: boolean;
};

interface NotificationStoreState {
  items: NotificationItem[];
  popupIds: string[];
}

let state: NotificationStoreState = {
  items: [],
  popupIds: [],
};

const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
let idCounter = 0;

function emit() {
  for (const listener of listeners) {
    listener();
  }
}

function createId() {
  idCounter += 1;
  return `notif-${Date.now()}-${idCounter}`;
}

function addNotification(
  title: React.ReactNode,
  options: NotifyOptions = {},
  overrideType?: NotificationType,
): string {
  const id = options.id ?? createId();
  const item: NotificationItem = {
    id,
    title,
    description: options.description,
    type: overrideType ?? options.type ?? "default",
    timestamp: options.timestamp ?? "Just now",
    read: false,
    avatarUrl: options.avatarUrl,
    icon: options.icon,
    duration: options.duration ?? 4000,
    action: options.action,
  };

  state = {
    items: [item, ...state.items.filter((i) => i.id !== id)],
    popupIds: options.silent
      ? state.popupIds
      : [...state.popupIds.filter((pid) => pid !== id), id],
  };
  emit();
  return id;
}

export const notify = Object.assign(
  (title: React.ReactNode, options?: NotifyOptions) =>
    addNotification(title, options),
  {
    success: (title: React.ReactNode, options?: NotifyOptions) =>
      addNotification(title, options, "success"),
    info: (title: React.ReactNode, options?: NotifyOptions) =>
      addNotification(title, options, "info"),
    warning: (title: React.ReactNode, options?: NotifyOptions) =>
      addNotification(title, options, "warning"),
    error: (title: React.ReactNode, options?: NotifyOptions) =>
      addNotification(title, options, "error"),
    seed: (items: NotificationItem[]) => {
      state = { items, popupIds: [] };
      emit();
    },
    dismissPopup: (id: string) => {
      if (!state.popupIds.includes(id)) return;
      state = {
        ...state,
        popupIds: state.popupIds.filter((pid) => pid !== id),
      };
      emit();
    },
    markAsRead: (id: string) => {
      state = {
        items: state.items.map((item) =>
          item.id === id ? { ...item, read: true } : item,
        ),
        popupIds: state.popupIds.filter((pid) => pid !== id),
      };
      emit();
    },
    markAllRead: () => {
      state = {
        items: state.items.map((item) => ({ ...item, read: true })),
        popupIds: [],
      };
      emit();
    },
    remove: (id: string) => {
      state = {
        items: state.items.filter((item) => item.id !== id),
        popupIds: state.popupIds.filter((pid) => pid !== id),
      };
      emit();
    },
    clear: () => {
      state = { items: [], popupIds: [] };
      emit();
    },
  },
);

function subscribe(listener: () => void) {
  listeners.add(listener);
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(listener);
  };
}

function getSnapshot() {
  return state;
}

const DEFAULT_POPUP_DURATION = 4000;
const TICK_MS = 50;

export function useNotifications(
  isPaused: boolean,
  defaultDuration = DEFAULT_POPUP_DURATION,
) {
  const snapshot = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getSnapshot);
  const [selectedPopupId, setSelectedPopupId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [direction, setDirection] = useState<1 | -1>(1);
  const [progressState, setProgressState] = useState<{
    id: string | null;
    value: number;
  }>({
    id: null,
    value: 1,
  });

  const timersRef = useRef<
    Map<string, { remaining: number; duration: number }>
  >(new Map());

  const popupItems = snapshot.popupIds
    .map((id) => snapshot.items.find((item) => item.id === id))
    .filter((item): item is NotificationItem => Boolean(item));

  const selectedIndex =
    selectedPopupId !== null
      ? popupItems.findIndex((item) => item.id === selectedPopupId)
      : -1;
  const activeIndex =
    popupItems.length === 0
      ? 0
      : selectedIndex !== -1
        ? selectedIndex
        : popupItems.length - 1;
  const activePopup = popupItems.length > 0 ? popupItems[activeIndex] : null;

  // Sync popup timer map via ref only
  useEffect(() => {
    const nextMap = new Map<string, { remaining: number; duration: number }>();
    for (const item of popupItems) {
      const existing = timersRef.current.get(item.id);
      const targetDuration = item.duration ?? defaultDuration;
      if (existing) {
        nextMap.set(item.id, existing);
      } else {
        nextMap.set(item.id, {
          remaining: targetDuration,
          duration: targetDuration,
        });
      }
    }
    timersRef.current = nextMap;
  }, [popupItems, defaultDuration]);

  // Countdown tick for the currently visible live popup
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activePopup || isPaused) return;
    const duration = activePopup.duration ?? defaultDuration;
    if (duration === Infinity) return;

    let lastTick = performance.now();
    const activeId = activePopup.id;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      const now = performance.now();
      const delta = now - lastTick;
      lastTick = now;

      const current = timersRef.current.get(activeId);
      if (!current || current.duration === Infinity) return;

      const nextRemaining = Math.max(0, current.remaining - delta);
      current.remaining = nextRemaining;
      setProgressState({
        id: activeId,
        value: current.duration > 0 ? nextRemaining / current.duration : 0,
      });

      if (nextRemaining <= 0) {
        clearInterval(interval);
        setDirection(1);
        if (popupItems.length > 1) {
          const nextIdx = (activeIndex + 1) % popupItems.length;
          const nextItem = popupItems[nextIdx];
          setSelectedPopupId(
            nextItem && nextItem.id !== activeId ? nextItem.id : null,
          );
        } else {
          setSelectedPopupId(null);
        }
        notify.dismissPopup(activeId);
      }
    }, TICK_MS);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [activePopup, activeIndex, popupItems, isPaused, defaultDuration]);

  const nextPopup = useCallback(() => {
    if (popupItems.length <= 1) return;
    setDirection(1);
    const nextIdx = (activeIndex + 1) % popupItems.length;
    setSelectedPopupId(popupItems[nextIdx].id);
  }, [popupItems, activeIndex]);

  const unreadCount = snapshot.items.filter((i) => !i.read).length;
  const activeProgress =
    !activePopup ||
    (activePopup.duration ?? defaultDuration) === Infinity ||
    progressState.id !== activePopup.id
      ? 1
      : progressState.value;

  return {
    notifications: snapshot.items,
    unreadCount,
    popupItems,
    activePopup,
    activeIndex,
    direction,
    activeProgress,
    nextPopup,
  };
}

"use client";

import React, { useEffect } from "react";
import {
  NotificationIsland,
  notify,
} from "@/registry/components/notification-island";

const INITIAL_NOTIFICATIONS = [
  {
    id: "seed-1",
    title: "Production deploy succeeded",
    description: "up2px-ui v0.4.2 is live on Cloudflare Pages edge.",
    type: "success" as const,
    timestamp: "4m ago",
    read: false,
  },
  {
    id: "seed-2",
    title: "Sarah mentioned you in #design-system",
    description: "Can we align the pill radius with the new sidebar cards?",
    type: "info" as const,
    avatarUrl:
      "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1494790108377-be9c29b29330?w=64&h=64&fit=crop&crop=faces",
    timestamp: "18m ago",
    read: false,
  },
  {
    id: "seed-3",
    title: "Invoice #1042 paid",
    description: "$49.00 received from Acme Studio.",
    type: "default" as const,
    timestamp: "2h ago",
    read: true,
  },
];

export default function NotificationIslandDemo() {
  useEffect(() => {
    notify.seed(INITIAL_NOTIFICATIONS);
  }, []);

  function sendBurstAlerts() {
    notify.info("Alex commented on Pull Request #84", {
      description: "Looks clean — ready to merge once CI passes.",
      avatarUrl:
        "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1507003211169-0a1dd7228f2d?w=64&h=64&fit=crop&crop=faces",
    });
    setTimeout(() => {
      notify.warning("API rate limit at 85%", {
        description: "Consider enabling edge caching on /r/*.json.",
      });
    }, 160);
    setTimeout(() => {
      notify.success("Build exported in 1.4s", {
        description: "All 12 static component pages generated.",
        action: {
          label: "Inspect",
          onClick: () => notify.info("Opened build inspector"),
        },
      });
    }, 320);
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex w-full flex-col items-center gap-20 py-6">
      {/* Simulated SaaS Dashboard Header Bar */}
      <div className="relative flex w-full max-w-2xl items-center justify-between rounded-3xl border border-accent/25 bg-background/25 bg-[linear-gradient(155deg,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--accent)_9%,transparent),transparent_48%)] px-4 py-3 shadow-[0_16px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] ring-1 inset-shadow-[0_0_14px_rgba(255,59,0,0.07)] ring-white/35 backdrop-blur-2xl backdrop-saturate-150 dark:bg-background/30 dark:shadow-[0_16px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.45)] dark:ring-white/12">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <span className="size-2.5 rounded-full bg-accent" />
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
            Acme Workspace
          </span>
          <span className="rounded bg-surface-secondary px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
            PRO
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="relative z-20 flex items-center gap-3">
          <NotificationIsland align="right" />
          <img
            src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb?w=64&h=64&fit=crop&crop=faces"
            alt="Workspace Member"
            className="size-8 rounded-full border border-border object-cover"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Interactive Demo Controls */}
      <div className="flex max-w-xl flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() =>
            notify.success("Changes synced", {
              description: "Workspace preferences saved to cloud.",
            })
          }
          className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-surface-secondary"
        >
          Trigger Success Alert
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={sendBurstAlerts}
          className="rounded-lg bg-accent px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"
        >
          Burst 3 Alerts (Split Arrow)
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() =>
            notify.error("Webhook delivery failed", {
              description: "Endpoint returned HTTP 502 after 3 retries.",
              action: {
                label: "Retry",
                onClick: () => notify.success("Webhook delivered"),
              },
            })
          }
          className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-destructive transition-colors hover:bg-surface-secondary"
        >
          Trigger Error + Action
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => notify.seed(INITIAL_NOTIFICATIONS)}
          className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-transparent px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground"
        >
          Reset History
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
